newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 8.089 bln levs 1-wk, 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 8.089 bln levs 1-wk, 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold on Tuesday two discount T-bill issues with one- and four-week maturities, yielding 3.72 percent and 17.58 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total 8.189 billion levs ($3.1 million) of T-bills, but the ministry approved bids for 8.089 billion.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance by the ministry.
Bids received 6,771 million levs 1,418 million levs
Avg price of bids 96.40 pct 85.05 pct
Bids approved 6,671 million levs 1,418 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.72 pct 17.58 pct
